content.short: Loaded Lions: Mane City is a tycoon simulator game featuring Web3’s most fabulous felines.
content.description: Loaded Lions: Mane City is a tycoon-style simulation in which you begin with a plot of land that passively generates Diamonds and serves as the reliable foundation for developing a growing network of interconnected businesses. These businesses consistently produce Gold, and as you accumulate Gold you can upgrade your businesses to increase Gold production over time. In Competitive Mode, players compete on the leaderboard for a chance to win special prizes.
